This tool integrates measuring, marking and scribing functions, widely used for woodworking marking, architectural drawing, engineering layout and DIY handcraft projects.

Silver and black color options are available, suitable for hardware stores, wholesale distribution and cross-border bulk orders.

Key Features

  1. Dual Metric & Imperial Graduations
